Combined R8:R7 - 32-bit data register for writing 32-bit values into RAM (R8=HI word R7=LO word)

column1: R32 is not a separate physical register. It is an alias for the R8:R7 register pair.
Write the high 16 bits of the 32-bit DATA into R8 and the low 16 bits into R7.
STR32 ADDR will write the combined R8:R7 value as a 32-bit word into RAM at ADDR.
Example: MOVI R7 0x1234 then MOVI R8 0xABCD then STR32 0x0300 writes 0xABCD1234 to RAM.
